stories.headline: Anthropic Secures Major Computing Capacity from CoreWeave to Power Claude Expansion
stories.summary: Anthropic has agreed to a multiyear deal with CoreWeave Inc. to access significant data center capacity for Claude AI services. The partnership provides access to multiple Nvidia chip architectures across US data centers, helping Anthropic meet surging demand and supporting continued expansion of its AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: Claude Mythos Preview Discovers Thousands of Zero-Day Vulnerabilities Across Major Systems
stories.summary: Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview model, released as part of Project Glasswing, has identified thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities across major operating systems and web browsers that survived decades of human review. The breakthrough model is being shared with over 50 tech organizations with $100 million in usage credits to advance cybersecurity capabilities.

stories.headline: Claude Managed Agents Enter Public Beta with Enterprise Sandbox and Tool Integration
stories.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Managed Agents in public beta, offering a fully managed agent harness for running Claude as an autonomous agent with secure sandboxing, built-in tools, and server-sent event streaming. Claude Cowork also graduated from research preview on macOS, introducing new enterprise capabilities.

stories.headline: Federal Court Rejects Anthropic's Challenge to Pentagon AI Blacklist, Sets May Oral Arguments
stories.summary: A federal appeals court in Washington rejected Anthropic's bid to immediately halt the Pentagon's blacklisting of Claude from U.S. military contracts. Expedited oral arguments are scheduled for May 19, 2026, as the legal battle over AI restrictions in defense applications continues.

stories.headline: Claude Code March 2026 Update: Computer Use, Auto Mode, and Major Capability Expansion
stories.summary: Claude Code received substantial updates in March 2026 including computer use for agentic tasks, auto mode for autonomous work, and cloud auto-fix for PR management. The release also features improved visualization support, faster Write tool performance, and new security permissions for mobile approval forwarding.
